SnapshotStatusPhase.description:
- PENDING: PENDING is a snapshot that has been accepted but not yet started.
 - QUIESCING: QUIESCING is a snapshot whose source microvm is being quiesced.
 - CAPTURING: CAPTURING is a snapshot whose memory, device and volume state is being captured.
 - PACKAGING: PACKAGING is a snapshot whose captured state is being packaged.
 - PUSHING: PUSHING is a snapshot whose package is being pushed to a registry.
 - READY: READY is a snapshot that is complete and can be restored.
 - FAILED: FAILED is a snapshot that has failed. Error contains the reason.

v1alpha1After.description:
After selects what happens to the source microvm once the snapshot is taken.

 - RESUME: RESUME resumes the source microvm.
 - STOP: STOP stops the source microvm. It is not supported yet.

sourceUid.description: SourceUID is the UID of the microvm to snapshot.
